notes.title: Astral Vangard Update v0.80 (08/04)
notes.notes:
Added to all Vangard (Player) a new animation. Each individual Vangard has had its own movement animation added to the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/464a7262f456a1be7c1c9fa0dfcef3e5e2287cf6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/afe46ef49fc6e27c124e30283603bb065eb081cd.png[/img]



A new Vangard is arrive, Astrion.

Player can unlock the new Vangard Astrion. for 2000 minerals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/d96dde6a8dc5f1533d80630a8440f478c79f124e.png[/img]

Astrion primary weapon is Lightning Shock:

[list]
[*] Lightning Shock Lv 1: Lightning impulse that hits all enemies in range with high rate of fire andlow speed. Damage (30), Cooldown (0.5s).

[*] Lightning Shock Lv 2: Increase Lightning Shock damage and rate of fire.
 Damage (45), Cooldown (0.4s).

[*] Lightning Shock Lv 3: Increase Lightning Shock at max damage and rate of fire.
Damage (70), Cooldown (0.3s).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/a6f43639ae790b8347d5c0264959e9d918bf6687.png[/img]


New Weapon added to Cosmic Forge, Phoenix Strike.

Player can Forge the new Weapon Phoenix Strike in Hangar-Cosmic Forge for 1000 minerals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/25f9137307fd033b6b8c32ecf7f38d0147f4f331.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Phoenix Strike Lv 1: A phoenix attack that descends and flies towards enemies at medium speed. Damage (100), Cooldown (3.5s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/a70bac9765e9bcb7a3aae41f573be49f93dc41fb.png[/img]


[*] Phoenix Strike Lv 2: Increases damage and reduces its cooldown.
Damage (150), Cooldown (2.5s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/9bd36cd948f28f45ec85204d65718471b35a2270.png[/img]


[*] Phoenix Strike Lv 3: Fires 2 Shoenix Strike and increase at max the damage and reduce its cooldown.
 Damage (200), Cooldown (1.5s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/bddcc713fa8a6be991404f8a73d6b97677e7e622.png[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes v0.77 (23/03)
notes.notes:
Bug Fix
[list]
[*] Fixed bug at the beginning of the map level the game was paused.
[*] Fixed bug where the game did not pause if the controller connected during the game was disconnected.
[/list]


End of Tribute to Akira Toriyama.

[list]
[*] Remove the limited time all "Vangard" will release their power in a ki energy aura.
[*] Remove the  limited time "Enemy Soldier" become "Slime Soldier ". Enemy Soldier return to the original design.
[/list]
